# Soakers

> Family-owned hot tub and swim spa dealer in Midvale, Utah. Authorized dealer for Artesian Spas (Island Spas, Artesian Elite), Nordic Hot Tubs, TidalFit Swim Spas, South Seas Spas, Garden Spas, and Covana automated covers. Full sales, service, repair, parts, and financing.

## Business details

- Address: 6905 S State St, Suite A, Midvale, UT 84047
- Phone: +1-801-838-7727 (801-838-SPAS)
- Email: service@soakers.biz
- Hours: Monday–Saturday, 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM (closed Sunday)
- Google rating: 4.8 stars from 94 reviews
- BBB: A+ accredited business
- Service area: Salt Lake County — Midvale, Salt Lake City, Sandy, Murray, West Jordan, South Jordan, Draper, and surrounding Utah cities
